claims: BIGBANG is scheduled to perform at the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival on the Outdoor Theatre stage on Sunday, April 12, and Sunday, April 19, 2026.
BIGBANG's set is scheduled for 10:30 PM local Pacific Time (PDT).
BIGBANG's performance time at Coachella 2026 is 10:30 PM – 11:30 PM (PDT - California Time).
Livestream of BIGBANG at Coachella 2026 is available on Coachella's YouTube Channel.
BIGBANG's performance times at Coachella 2026 are in Pacific Daylight Time (PDT).
